facts.text: In 1891, the Mammoth Mine Disaster claimed 110 lives when a firedamp explosion ripped through the mine, killing every miner inside.
A Pennsylvania Historical and Museum Commission marker was erected in 2000 at the burial site of the 1891 Mammoth Mine Explosion victims.
The only surviving structure from the old mine is a combined lamp house and boiler house, now visible behind the Mount Pleasant Township Municipal Building.
Mammoth’s Giant Slide Complex features two 100‑foot slides on a climbable rock wall, a modern recreation of the town’s historic metal slide.
The town sits just a few miles from the 1965 Kecksburg UFO incident site, where locals reported a mysterious object crashing in nearby woods.
The Mount Pleasant Township Municipal Building on Poker Road doubles as the town’s municipal hub and the former boiler house of the Mammoth Mine.
